tools.name: open_friday_flight_deals
tools.description: Open the Friday Flight Deals app, which shows the latest cheap flight deals. If you call this, do not also call get_latest_deals.

tools.name: get_latest_deals
tools.description: Fetch the latest cheap flight deals from the Friday Flight Deals newsletter (title, url, date, summary) to answer a question about them. It shows a deals widget, so skip it if open_friday_flight_deals was already called.

tools.name: score_flight_deal
tools.description: Rate a flight price from 0 to 100 against the typical fare for that route and cabin. Use when someone asks if a fare is a good deal.

from.description: Origin airport IATA code, e.g. JFK

to.description: Destination airport IATA code, e.g. LHR

tools.name: check_hidden_city_ticket
tools.description: Assess the risk of hidden-city ticketing: buying a ticket to a farther airport and getting off at the layover. Returns the saving, a verdict, deal-breakers, risks and the airline's policy.

from.description: Origin airport IATA code, e.g. JFK

to.description: Hub airport where you would actually get off, e.g. LHR

beyond.description: Final airport on the cheaper ticket, e.g. DUB, EDI, MAN, BRU, AMS for LHR

direct.description: Price of the normal ticket to your real destination, USD

throwaway.description: Price of the cheaper ticket to the airport beyond, USD

bag.description: True if you would check a bag

round_trip.description: True if the ticket is a return

loyalty.description: True if a frequent flyer number is on the booking

tools.name: find_route_fares
tools.description: Show the cheapest recent fares we track for an airport pair, by cabin, with the usual price and discount. Use when someone asks what a route costs right now.

from.description: Origin airport IATA code, e.g. JFK

to.description: Destination airport IATA code, e.g. LHR

tools.name: get_premium_cabin_guide
tools.description: Typical price, airlines, lounges and booking tips for business or first class to a destination such as japan, dubai, london, europe or hawaii.

tools.name: get_booking_tips
tools.description: Answer when to book, which day is cheapest to fly and how far ahead to buy, with data-backed tips. Optionally filter by topic keywords.

topic.description: Optional keywords to filter tips, e.g. cheapest day, how far in advance
